title: Add cogitor to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [cogitor](https://github.com/SkalaSkalolaz/cogitor) to writing
- **_Cogitor AI_** — lightweight AI chat on Go with a web interface and desktop GUI, supporting multiple LLM providers, local models, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Web Search, RAG, Vision, conversation histor

Fixes #14946

gist.headline: A new cog in writing
gist.blurb: Cogitor AI has joined the writing garden: a lightweight chat companion for drafting, searching, and talking to a small forest of models. Polli has put it on the shelf next to the good pencils.
gist.summary: Added Cogitor AI to the writing app collection, highlighting its Go-based web and desktop chat interface with multi-provider LLM support, local models, web search, RAG, vision, and conversation history.
gist.impact: People browsing writing tools can now discover Cogitor as a lightweight option for AI-assisted writing and research across hosted or local models.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Cogitor as a cozy writing workstation: a small retro computer showing a chat-and-draft interface, surrounded by notebooks, a fountain pen, and sprouting code-plants to represent its Go-based multi-model, search, RAG, and vision capabilities. Polli wears tiny round writer glasses and helps arrange pages, making the app-directory addition feel like a new friendly tool joining the garden.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art writing nook where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and tiny round writer glasses, helps a retro desktop computer draft a page in a simple chat interface; notebooks, a fountain pen, and little code-plants with magnifying-glass and image icons grow around it, representing Cogitor's multi-model chat, web search, RAG, and vision tools. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, pixel-font text: "COGITOR", nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
